findings.claim: The browser memory gate can pass even when total isolated Chromium RSS growth exceeds the acceptance limit because it enforces only the single target renderer delta.
findings.evidence: Acceptance A requires the browser campaign to measure incremental RSS at or below 536870912 bytes; the script computes both `rss_delta` and `aggregate_rss_delta = peak_rss - baseline_rss` but sets `rss_within_budget = rss_delta <= RSS_LIMIT` and `passed = browser_result.get("result") == "Passed" and rss_within_budget and heap_within_budget`, leaving `aggregate_rss_delta` report-only.
findings.suggested_fix: Fail the campaign when aggregate browser-process-tree RSS growth exceeds `RSS_LIMIT`, or change the acceptance contract and receipt schema to explicitly define the limit as target-renderer-only.

findings.claim: The generated report records a non-runnable command instead of the exact local command used for the runtime proof.
findings.evidence: Execution notes require: "Runtime proof must name and run the exact local command against owned fixtures"; the script writes `"command": "python3 scripts/test-ra11c-materialization.py"` even though its parser requires `--output` and the campaign depends on the selected timeout/data-dir arguments.
findings.suggested_fix: Populate the report command from `sys.argv` or include all effective arguments such as `--output`, `--timeout-seconds`, `--data-dir`, `--callback-port`, and `--campaign-secrets`.
